aviation_incidents.headline: Cessna Citation CJ1於賓州起飛時墜毀起火，兩人受傷
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架 Cessna Citation CJ1於2026年10月7日在賓州 Bedford County Airport 起飛時墜毀並起火。美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）表示，事故約於當地時間上午10時45分、飛機離場期間發生，該機構正在調查。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Cessna Citation CJ1 crashes and catches fire during takeoff in Pennsylvania
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Cessna Citation CJ1 crashed and caught fire during takeoff at Bedford County Airport in Pennsylvania on October 7, 2026. The Federal Aviation Administration said the crash occurred at about 10:45 a.m. local time during departure and that it is investigating.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 俄亥俄州未來論壇聚焦臺灣無人機產業 臺美將續建可信賴供應鏈
taiwan_aviation.summary: 美國俄亥俄州年度「未來論壇」（Future Forum）8日在東自由市（East Liberty）交通研發中心舉行，論壇以科技、基建與運輸製造為主題。臺灣專場聚焦半導體、無人機及輪胎科技，並探討自駕計程車、無人卡車與無人載具快遞貨運等交通科技發展。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Ohio Future Forum spotlights Taiwan's drone industry and supply-chain ties
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Ohio's annual Future Forum, focused on technology, infrastructure, and transport manufacturing, was held on the 8th at a transportation research center in East Liberty. The Taiwan session focused on semiconductors, drones, and tire technology, as well as developments including self-driving taxis, autonomous trucks, and uncrewed-vehicle delivery and freight.

international_aviation.headline: X-BAT無人戰機新增美海軍1.5億美元資金　公私投入承諾累計4億美元
international_aviation.summary: Shield AI 10月8日宣佈，美國海軍在既有協議追加1.5億美元，支援X-BAT無人垂直起降戰機的出口適用功能，公司將另投入相同金額。加計8月政府5,000萬及公司5,000萬美元，累計公私部門承諾4億美元；不能把總額全寫成海軍撥款。
international_aviation.headline_en: X-BAT public and private commitments reach USD400 million
international_aviation.summary_en: Shield AI announced on October 8 a USD150 million US Navy modification supporting exportability features for X-BAT, matched by USD150 million of company investment. Separate August commitments of USD50 million each from government and company bring announced public and private commitments to USD400 million. That total is not all Navy funding.

international_aviation.headline: RwandAir執行長呼籲為非洲航空市場落實設定期限
international_aviation.summary: 第10屆 Aviation Africa Summit 於2026年9月9日至10日在 Sarit Expo Centre 舉行。RwandAir 執行長 Yvonne Makolo 在航空公司場次表示，政府、民航主管機關及航空公司應為落實非洲單一航空運輸市場設定明確期限，並推動執行，而非停留於討論與簽署。
international_aviation.headline_en: RwandAir chief urges deadlines for implementing Africa’s single aviation market
international_aviation.summary_en: At the 10th Aviation Africa Summit, held at the Sarit Expo Centre on September 9 and 10, 2026, RwandAir chief executive Yvonne Makolo said governments, civil aviation authorities and airlines needed fixed deadlines for implementing the Single African Air Transport Market (SAATM). She said the industry needed to move beyond talking and signing and deliver implementation.
